method: § 39b (3) EStG sonstige Bezüge: annual wage-tax difference with and without the payment (BMF PAP 2026)

lines.label: Wage tax (Lohnsteuer) on the one-off payment
lines.note: Annual wage tax with the payment minus annual wage tax without it (§ 39b (3) EStG, PAP 2026 method MSONST).

lines.label: Solidarity surcharge
lines.note: 5.5%, nil below the annual exemption, mitigated just above it (SolzG §§ 3, 4).

notes: Wage tax on a sonstiger Bezug: the employer works out the annual wage tax on the expected annual pay without the payment and with it; the difference is withheld (§ 39b (3) EStG). Computed with the BMF Programmablaufplan 2026 (monthly payroll, regularAnnual as the expected annual pay).

Set fuenftel=true for severance for the loss of the job or remuneration for work over more than 12 months spanning two calendar years (§ 34 (2) Nr. 2 and 4 EStG): the five-fold method then applies in the assessment.
Liability assumes the assessment has no other income or deductions: taxable income = pay − Vorsorgepauschale − fixed allowances as in the annual wage-tax table.

Social contributions: a one-time payment is contributory only up to the pro-rata annual ceiling for January to month 12, less the regular pay already contributory (§ 23a (3) SGB IV): pension/unemployment ceiling €8,450 a month, health/care €5,812.5 a month. Assumes employment with this employer for the whole year to date at the same monthly pay.
